title: OFSCP GET /api/providers response (v0.1)
description: A provider's optional list of known peer providers (§8.6). How the list is maintained is provider-defined; a provider MAY decline to maintain or to share it (404/403).

domain.description: Peer provider domain; its discovery document is at https://{domain}/.well-known/ofscp-provider (§3.1).
